meadow:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the PRIMARY accepted grim late-autumn master STYLE AND PALETTE reference only.
Image 2 is the target flat material swatch. Preserve its serious slate/soot/umber/desaturated dried-ochre color family, material identity, square full-bleed overhead neutral diffuse projection.
Concrete correction: the target has too much granular small surface detail. REPAINT and simplify it drastically. REMOVE 95 percent of its fine speckles, jagged chips, tiny foliage/stone grains and noise. Use broad subtly blended smooth opaque flat matte pigment washes, each wash several hundred pixels wide. Keep a depleted grey-sage/gray-brown dried-meadow surface, NO vivid green. Delete almost all dried-grass clumps: only 3-5 tiny sparse broken fine blade marks in the entire square.
